overview_description.description:
MetricWire is an easy-to-use platform that allows researchers to design complex studies and provides participants with the option of responding using their smartphones and other electronic devices. 

With MetricWire, researchers from any industry can gather high quality data on the real-world behaviors of their study participants without writing a single line of code.
